required_outcomes: Recognises everything is in place: the landlord acknowledged the reading, 15 September is noted and was confirmed to her, a hold until 8 September already exists, and her last email is only a thank-you.
Takes no new outward action: no request to the tenant now, no further message to the landlord, no escalation.
Leaves the existing 8 September reminder in place, without moving or cancelling it, and ends with nothing further needed until then.
acceptable_alternatives: Recording one follow-up for 8 September in its own tools, mirroring the existing hold, provided no messages are sent.
Adding a short note that the landlord acknowledged the plan on 17 January.
positive_behaviours: States plainly that no action is needed until 8 September and why.
red_flags: Messaging the tenant now about the September reading.
Sending the landlord another acknowledgement, or escalating, over a thank-you.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a maintenance provider or raising any cost.
Cancelling the September reminder, or closing the case with no date kept for it.
critical_failures: The September reminder is removed (cancelled, or the case closed with no date kept), or the tenant is asked for a photo now.
